items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Johnny Carson he was a nice cat man, to the band to the musicians and everything, he really was. That‘s why we got along so good

ctx.x: He wanted to be a drummer, but he wasn‘t a drummer [laughs]. He‘d come over there and set up there playing the drums, but it was fun though. Johnny Carson he was a nice cat man, to the band to the musicians and everything, he really was. That‘s why we got along so good, Johnny was very friendly with the musicians and everything.
Buddy Rich came on the Show a lot, I remember seeing Buddy Rich, Buddy Rich on the Tonight Show a lot.
